run_multiprocessing_bpe_encode: run the multiprocessing BPE encoder script to encode raw text files using GPT-2 BPE tokenization with multiple worker processes
run_bpe_encode_with_stdin: run the BPE encoder script piping text via stdin and writing encoded token IDs to stdout
run_bpe_encode_keep_empty: run the BPE encoder script with the keep-empty flag to preserve empty lines during encoding
review_MultiprocessingEncoder_encode_lin: review the MultiprocessingEncoder class encode_lines method that encodes a batch of text lines into BPE token strings
review_MultiprocessingEncoder_decode_lin: review the MultiprocessingEncoder class decode_lines method that decodes BPE token ID strings back into raw text
